notes: ἕως ἄν joined as one `aligned` unit on *till* per rule 50's MAT.10.11 and MAT.10.23 reading; ἀπ᾿ ἄρτι joined `noncompositional` per rule 93's ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν test, ἄρτι alone never carrying *henceforth*.
οὐ μή takes the whole English negation as one `noncompositional` unit headed on οὐ, the ASV writing only *not* (rule 33).
The Greek writes no ἐστίν, so the italicized *is* is the supplied copula on the predicate participle (rules 11, 53).
